contain:New septic tank with soak pit.note: Household septic tank (C07, 10-15 users) plus a soak pit (C21), divided among the households one tank serves. C03 is not used: it is priced as a 90-100-user community toilet, not a connection. A shared 90-100-user tank with soak pit (C20) would cost about a quarter as much per household.

contain:Connect septic tank to soak pit.note: One soak pit (C21) per existing tank, divided among the households one tank serves. C21 is priced for a 90-100-user pit, so this is generous for a household tank.

contain:Convert dug hole to VIP latrine.note: C05 is priced for 5 users, including the latrine structure.

contain:Cluster DEWATS for outlets.note: C01B, a 285-300-user DEWATS, divided among the households it serves. Land is not included.

contain:Replace with sealed, fully lined.note: Not priced: C24 was left blank.

shared_treatment.note: C01B (285-300 users) priced per m3 a day of the wastewater those users produce. C02 is not used: its price for a 50,000-100,000-person plant works out at about 1/40 of DEWATS per m3, which needs checking.

vehicles.note: C30, 1,000-2,000 litre vacuum tanker. The engineer notes the price is for the tanker only: confirm whether the truck is included.

fstp.note: C12 is priced per plant for a town of 50,000-100,000 people (Saidpur), land excluded, drying beds and compost area included. Turned into a rate per m3 a day with the reference capacity in the sizing rules.

beds.note: Drying beds are part of the treatment plant price (C12), so they cost nothing extra here. C34 was left blank.

land.note: C35, land in the municipality. Varies with centre or edge of town.

collection.note: S03, 500-800 litre paddle or battery rickshaw van.

bins.note: S01, one 10-20 litre bin with lid for each household newly collected.

compost.note: Not used: S06 is given per tonne a day but specified as 4-6 tonnes a month and sourced from the Saidpur sludge compost shed, so it is not a price for an organic-waste compost plant. Needs the engineer to confirm.

disposal.note: Not priced: S08 was left blank.
